metadata.title: Utah Outdoor Seed Data (DEMO)
metadata.description: A small, hand-curated sample of Utah national parks and popular trails for demonstration only.
metadata.provenance: Hand-authored from general knowledge. Coordinates, distances, and difficulty are APPROXIMATE and were NOT verified against any official source or dataset. Do not use for navigation, planning, or safety decisions.
metadata.disclaimer: Demo data - not authoritative. Verify everything with official sources (e.g. the NPS, land managers) before relying on it.

properties.name: Zion National Park
properties.description: Towering sandstone cliffs, the Virgin River, and iconic hikes like Angels Landing and The Narrows.

properties.name: Bryce Canyon National Park
properties.description: Famous for its vast amphitheaters of red-rock hoodoos best seen at sunrise.

properties.name: Arches National Park
properties.description: Home to more than 2,000 natural stone arches, including the iconic Delicate Arch.

properties.name: Canyonlands National Park
properties.description: A rugged landscape of canyons, mesas, and buttes carved by the Colorado and Green rivers.

properties.name: Capitol Reef National Park
properties.description: A hidden gem centered on the Waterpocket Fold, with orchards, cliffs, and slot canyons.

properties.name: Angels Landing
properties.description: A thrilling, exposed ridge climb with chains and 1,000+ ft drop-offs. Permit required.

properties.name: The Narrows (Bottom-Up)
properties.description: Wade and hike up the Virgin River between soaring canyon walls. Distance depends on turnaround point.

properties.name: Observation Point
properties.description: A high viewpoint looking down on Angels Landing and the canyon. Often hiked from the East Mesa trailhead.

properties.name: Emerald Pools
properties.description: A family-friendly loop past lower, middle, and upper pools with seasonal waterfalls.

properties.name: Canyon Overlook Trail
properties.description: A short walk to a big view over lower Zion Canyon, near the east tunnel.

properties.name: Delicate Arch Trail
properties.description: An open slickrock climb to Utah's most famous arch. Little shade - bring water.

properties.name: Landscape Arch
properties.description: A mostly flat walk to one of the longest natural stone spans in the world.

properties.name: Devils Garden Loop
properties.description: A longer loop past multiple arches with some scrambling along narrow fins.

properties.name: Park Avenue Trail
properties.description: A walk down a dramatic canyon lined with towering sandstone walls and monoliths.

properties.name: Navajo Loop Trail
properties.description: Switchbacks down through Wall Street into a forest of hoodoos.

properties.name: Queens Garden Trail
properties.description: The gentlest descent into the Bryce amphitheater - great for families.

properties.name: Peekaboo Loop
properties.description: A rolling loop deep among the hoodoos, sharing tread with horse trips in season.

properties.name: Mesa Arch Trail
properties.description: A short loop to a cliff-edge arch framing the canyons - a sunrise photography classic.

properties.name: Grand View Point Trail
properties.description: An easy rim walk on Island in the Sky with sweeping canyon-country panoramas.

properties.name: Chesler Park Loop
properties.description: A demanding loop through the Needles district's colorful spires and the Joint Trail slots.

properties.name: Hickman Bridge Trail
properties.description: A rewarding walk to a 133-ft natural bridge with canyon and river views.

properties.name: Cassidy Arch
properties.description: A slickrock climb to an arch you can actually stand on top of, above Grand Wash.

properties.name: Cohab Canyon Trail
properties.description: Switchbacks to a hidden canyon with mini slots and overlooks of the Fruita orchards.

properties.name: Ensign Peak Trail
properties.description: A short, steep city hike with sweeping views over the Salt Lake Valley.

properties.name: Donut Falls
properties.description: A popular family hike to a waterfall that pours through a hole in the rock.

properties.name: Lake Blanche Trail
properties.description: A steady climb to an alpine lake beneath Sundial Peak - a Wasatch classic.

properties.name: Cecret Lake Trail
properties.description: A short, scenic hike to a mountain lake, famous for summer wildflowers near Alta.

properties.name: Mount Timpanogos Summit
properties.description: A long, strenuous summit day to one of the Wasatch's highest peaks. Start early.

properties.name: Corona Arch
properties.description: A slickrock route with safety cables to a huge freestanding arch outside Moab.

properties.name: Dead Horse Point Rim Trail
properties.description: An easy rim loop above a gooseneck of the Colorado River with dramatic overlooks.
